lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: Nobody reaches the Heavenly City alone. Your team will need you, too.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Then I’ll take the first step with them.

lines.speaker: Diago
lines.text: You do not learn to protect people by waiting until you feel brave. Stand with your team.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: The road is safer now. Let’s use what we found before we go on.

lines.speaker: Diago
lines.text: You held your ground. Now learn when to strike and when to let someone help.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: That is why we brought a team.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: I still remember the flood. I don’t want fear to choose for me again.

lines.speaker: Diago
lines.text: Then choose the next right step. We will take it together.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: You don’t have to face that fear alone. Watch my flank, and I’ll watch yours.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Together, then.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: There are others who need this crossing. We cannot leave the road like this.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: One stretch at a time. Keep everyone close.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: The crossing is behind us. Check the wounded before we press on.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: We keep moving as a team.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: That creature is blocking the way. Ready?

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Ready enough to stand beside you.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: The guild can be rebuilt. First, we keep the road safe for those helping us.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Then that is where we begin.

lines.speaker: Hailey
lines.text: Everything feels different after the attack.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: We can still choose what we do for one another.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: Fear does not disappear because you hide it. Stay with the formation.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: And stay with us.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: We have carried our fears this far. We do not have to carry them alone.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: Then let’s finish the crossing.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Protecting people means noticing the lives beyond the battlefield.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: The farmers need a safe road. We can give them that.

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.text: We hold the path. They bring their families through.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: No one gets left behind.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: Their attacks are coordinated. We must keep our own line together.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: I can protect the team without trying to control every step.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Strength is not yours alone to carry.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: I’ll trust the others to stand with me.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Rex calls dependence weakness. He has forgotten what love can endure.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Then we will show it by how we fight together.

lines.speaker: Hailey
lines.text: There are so many of them.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Look at us, Hailey. You are not facing them alone.

lines.speaker: Hailey
lines.text: I can help keep everyone standing.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: Then we will make room for your light.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Hold your purpose when the fire comes.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Protect one another. That is our way through.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Not every voice in this canyon tells the truth. Remember who stands beside you.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: I remember.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: The road keeps trying to split us up.

lines.speaker: Amaya
lines.text: Then we give it no opening.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: My failures do not have to decide what I do now.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Stand in that truth.

lines.speaker: Isaac
lines.text: Together to the end.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Together.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: The light is closer. Check on everyone before we go on.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: There is still a road to walk.

lines.speaker: Hailey
lines.text: We have come so far.

lines.speaker: Waiz
lines.text: And we are bringing everyone with us.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Others will follow this road. Leave it safer than we found it.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: Then our journey can help theirs.

lines.speaker: Sarko
lines.text: I can protect them and love them. I do not have to be their savior.

lines.speaker: Levi
lines.text: Walk forward, Shepherd.

opening.text: Where am I? The storm... I thought the water would never end.
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: This room, this armour... is all of this really for me?
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: Then we begin together.
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: We helped mend their fences, and somehow this little garden feels greater than a victory.
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: Then we share it. Whatever waits ahead, nobody carries it alone.
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: You will not take them. Everyone, stay together!
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: I could not have done that by myself.
opening.speaker: Sarko

opening.text: Hello! My name is Waiz. You are safe in First Light. Take a breath.
opening.speaker: Waiz

opening.text: Yes. But nobody walks this new road alone. Your team will need you, and you will need them.
opening.speaker: Waiz

opening.text: And I will try not to call all my screaming tactical enthusiasm.
opening.speaker: Waiz

opening.text: Home at last! Everyone, meet Sarko. He survived Diago’s training. Mostly.
opening.speaker: Waiz

opening.text: For the record, the evil panther started it.
opening.speaker: Waiz

opening.text: I am Diago. A Shepherd protects the others. Today you learn by standing beside us.
opening.speaker: Diago

opening.text: Watch whose turn it is. Use a basic attack, or choose a ready skill. Healing keeps a companion in the fight.
opening.speaker: Diago

opening.text: Choose your companions for the road. Speak, listen, and make room for their gifts.
opening.speaker: Diago

opening.text: Evolution shards. A gift entrusted to the whole company, not a prize for one champion.
opening.speaker: Diago

opening.text: He is stronger than us. Protect each other and hold the line. We need time.
opening.speaker: Diago

opening.text: Surviving is a beginning. I am Amaya. My spear will hold the flank.
opening.speaker: Amaya

opening.text: Shield brother! Isaac. When the road gets rough, stand beside me.
opening.speaker: Isaac

opening.text: I am Hailey. My bow can reach the threats you cannot. You can count on me.
opening.speaker: Hailey

opening.text: I am Naomi. I carry a crossbow, but listening is also part of protecting our friends.
opening.speaker: Naomi

opening.text: Be still. We are not alone here.
opening.speaker: Naomi

opening.text: He is here.
opening.speaker: Naomi

opening.text: Grace. An evangelist’s courage means little unless it helps someone else stand. My sword is with you.
opening.speaker: Grace

opening.text: Bearer of restoration. Those who walk in unity may receive what lies within. Remain as one.
opening.speaker: Angel

opening.text: So... Heaven chose another. Tell me, Shepherd: how long before your light breaks?
opening.speaker: Malachar

opening.text: When we meet again, I will not be alone.
opening.speaker: Malachar

opening.text: I leave for one supply run, and you nearly destroy headquarters.
opening.speaker: Levi

opening.text: Formation seven. Sarko and Isaac, hold the front. Watch for my signal. Now—together!
opening.speaker: Levi

opening.text: You lost the moment you came alone.
opening.speaker: Levi

opening.text: You were never asked to. Take your companions. The road beyond First Light is waiting.
opening.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: So... who is cleaning this up?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I am carrying this board. It is emotionally heavy.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then we should start by agreeing that the carved-stone game was unfair.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Prophet deer picks directions from now on.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I would prefer our next surprise to stay peaceful.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I joke because I hate feeling weak. I lost focus. I need your help.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: She said that so calmly!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Does this count as a team-building exercise?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: How do you even describe that?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Home.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then I suppose there are more people who need encouraging.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: New guy!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Adventure tomorrow. Food tonight!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I thought strength meant carrying everything alone. Shield brother shares the burden. So should I.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Formation twelve!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Fortress Titan!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Best team building!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Isaac

expandedStoryRecordings.text: What? I only just got here!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You think he will come back soon? You do not seem angry about the destruction.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: What happened to Malachar? He carries a mark like ours.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then healing has to mean more than closing a wound.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You have been carrying that all this time?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then we enter together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: We spent the morning repairing fences and helping tired families. For once, protecting people meant ordinary kindness.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Kingdom Sanctuary! Stay inside the light. We share the burden.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: He is not striking our armor. He is striking the things we hide from one another.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I do not have to control every outcome to stand beside you. Together—again!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: My sanctuary... he shattered it without trying.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Divine Restoration. Come back to the light, everyone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: This is not just power. It is purpose.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: But you did. We move forward together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: If my healing had no limits... could I keep everyone safe?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I remember what carried us here. Love—not control.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Kingdom Sanctuary! Isaac, beside me!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Divine Restoration! Stay with us.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I supported her. The regeneration is part of how the Creator made her. Love restores what power destroys.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Courage is not never being afraid. I can protect and love people without controlling everything that happens to them.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I thought I had to make up for it.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I can protect them. I can love them. But I am not their Savior.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I thought belonging was something I had to earn. Thank You for bringing us home.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Protect people?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: And none of them should have to walk alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You are carrying one board. Here—bring it to the damaged wall.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Amaya

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I judged you for mistakes I make myself. I carried pressure like pride instead of trust.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Amaya

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The wall is crooked on purpose. Artistic design.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I am afraid of failing you. So I force things and pretend I am in control.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: There are too many angles. I am afraid I will miss when you need me most.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Celestial Rain!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I almost did not shoot.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I can see the wing joints. Cover me while I aim.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: That was unpleasant. My bow—there. I can still fight.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: No pain. No exhaustion. I can hardly believe it.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Hailey

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Check everyone's wounds first. We rebuild together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I trained others before you. I lost people I wanted to protect. That is why I push you so hard.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Grace! Evangelist, enthusiastic volunteer, occasional ladder problem. Waiz, grab that end—wait, is anyone hurt? We should check first.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Right! Adventure, good news, possibly snacks. But if someone falls behind, we all stop. Nobody walks alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I had an inspiring speech ready. My knees have apparently voted against it. Stay close, will you?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: All right. One breath, one step, one wildly hopeful horse. Come on—we can do this together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Well, that was considerably more dragon than I ordered. Hey—look at me. You are safe with us. Nobody left.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: That is not a gift, Sarko. That is a chain with a very shiny ribbon. We already have you; you do not need to earn us.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Archers, I have your opening! Waiz, try to keep up. And please do not trip over my longsword.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Mercy! Unexpected, brilliant, and much better than another argument. Let us help him up—carefully.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Oh! Oh, look at the gates! I had so many words ready... Sarko, we actually made it. All of us.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then what are we waiting for? Well—one hug first. Then we carry that welcome to everyone still searching.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Grace

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Yes, he will return. But look at the town. Chadash Adamah means New Earth—not because it is free from suffering, but because God is rebuilding everything.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: A seed remains alone unless it enters the ground. Before something greater can grow, the seed must first break. Breaking hurts, but it is not the end.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: He once protected others. He saw loss and unanswered prayers, and decided that pain meant God could not be good. Pain did not destroy him. Hopelessness did.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You are a Shepherd. You remind others why they should keep going.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: We leave at sunrise. The Heavenly City awaits. The road will test your fear, your trust, and your hope. Nobody walks it alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I thought it was legend. Lower your shield, Sarko. This is an invitation.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Receive this gift together. Do not mistake growth for permission to stand alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: No. They forgot. Company, hold your formation.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: God does not unite perfect souls. He unites surrendered ones.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Rex Draconum. Why reveal yourself now?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: No. Love stayed when strength failed.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: And through the Son, we stand. This was not the end of our road.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Stand firm in faith. You do not have to carry this alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Creation does not surpass its Creator. God never feared humanity becoming powerful. He feared what pride would turn us into.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Everyone together! Protect the line. Watch for the opening.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Now! Every opening, cover one another. Together!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: No. This is what love looks like.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: And where did that road lead you?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You do not.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Our journey to the City is over. But our purpose is only beginning.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Levi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Heroes become family before they become legends. We can carry one another's burdens.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The path to the left was not safe. Sometimes God shows a moment before it happens.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The Hidden Garden...
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: That matters too. The light is not only for a battlefield.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Sarko—shield high, now! They are trying to split our attention.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Pride isolates. Humility reconnects.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The Spirit of God sustains us.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Sarko, do not listen. He is using your fear of failure.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: His power is consuming him. Do not let his anger break our formation.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Hailey! Sarko, she needs you!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: We are close.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Naomi

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Bearer of restoration, you carry the light of renewal. There is little time. Those who walk in unity may receive what lies within—but only those who remain as one.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Angel

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Faithful ones... continue.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Angel

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The King has awaited your arrival.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Angel

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You have grown quickly. Faster than I expected. This time, I did not come alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Malachar

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You still believe suffering has purpose? My companions chose truth after Heaven abandoned them.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Malachar

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Waiz hides fear behind laughter. Amaya carries guilt. Hailey fears failure. Your Apostle blames himself for every soul he cannot save.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Malachar

expandedStoryRecordings.text: My king.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Malachar

expandedStoryRecordings.text: My king, we can finish them.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Malachar

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Because hope grows dangerous when ignored. Allow me to correct your expectations.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You believe dependence protects people. Strength would have prevented your wounds.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then show me how long your faith endures when those you protect begin to fall.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: No. They are not ready. The Heavenly City will reveal whether their faith was ever real.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You heal, protect, sacrifice—and still you kneel. Why choose between light and darkness when both can belong to you?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: What if you no longer served Heaven, but surpassed it?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Stand together, so you may fall together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You restored what was destroyed...
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: So... this is what unity looks like.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: All this time, I thought strength meant never needing anyone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Rex

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I saw you in the rain.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Jesus

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You were never asked to become everyone's savior. You were called to follow Me faithfully.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Jesus

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Now you understand the heart of a Shepherd. You are home now.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Jesus

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Shepherd, your role remains unchanged.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Jesus

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Bring them together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Jesus

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Where am I? The storm... I thought the water would never end.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: My name is above the door. Someone expected me?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: That armour is enormous. I could never... wait. My paws. My reflection. I am not the small lion I remember.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: A dove on my forehead, and on my right paw. It is warm. I should be frightened, but somehow I feel safe.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: White metal, gold trim... and it fits. Even this shield feels as though it was made for me.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Someone is knocking. Uh... come in?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I am Sarko. You could say that. Is this really my home?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Back home, I never felt important. During a flood, people needed help and I froze. What if that happens again?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: That light beyond the mountains... it is beautiful. What is it?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: So I need to become stronger before I can go there?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: A Shepherd... that is what I am? And my team would actually need me?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then I want to learn. I do not want fear deciding who I become.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You could have started with that!
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Everyone smiles at me as though I belong here. I have not done anything to earn it yet.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Yes, sir. Although I am still learning what that means.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: What if I freeze when the others need me?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: All right. I am coming.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: So... where exactly are we going?
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: So winning is not just dealing the most damage. It is keeping everyone standing.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then we begin together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Sarko

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Hello! My name is Waiz! And judging by that expression, you have approximately a thousand questions.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: For now, yes. You are in First Light, in Chadash Adamah—the New Earth. Take a breath. You are safe here.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then you will have people beside you. That mark means you have been called, Sarko. It does not mean you must already know everything.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Come to the doorway. There is something you should see before we talk about monsters.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: The Heavenly City. Every Child of God journeys toward it. But listen carefully: nobody reaches it alone.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Stronger, yes. But not proud. No one receives every gift. A Shepherd protects and heals. An Evangelist guides and encourages. Together, we cover one another's weaknesses.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: They will. Your light is meant to help others stand when they are wounded or afraid. Miraculous Heal is a gift for them as much as for you.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: And protect that light with your choices. Being powerful is not the same as being kind. We learn to love, trust, forgive, and walk together.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Good! Because if you insist on doing everything alone, something with far too many teeth will eventually object.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Our leader is Levi, a tiger. You will meet him later. For now, explore the town. I will find our teacher, Diago, and catch up with you.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Sarko! Found you! Told you I would catch up. This is Diago.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: He sounds terrifying, but that was encouragement. I am almost certain.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: He means training. Probably. I will provide tactical enthusiasm.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Or use Auto and watch us work. Tap a skill in Auto to make it first priority when it becomes available. You can pause to think.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: You have us for this first road. One step, then another. Nobody expects you to know the whole journey today.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Waiz

expandedStoryRecordings.text: I am Diago. Teacher class. You are the new Shepherd.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Good. A student who knows he needs teaching can learn. Do not confuse potential with victory.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Then we practice before that moment comes. You are not here to prove you are stronger than your companions. If your pack lives, you win.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Eastern gate. Both of you. Bring the shield, Sarko. You will learn what it is for.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: To learn how you respond under pressure.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Plant your feet. Watch the enemy and your companions. Your shield buys them time; their gifts help you hold the line.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: In Manual mode, choose a basic attack or a ready skill when a hero's turn arrives. Read the skill description and cooldown before choosing.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Red numbers show damage. Blue marks a critical hit. Healing light and bright numbers show health restored. Pay attention to who needs help.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago

expandedStoryRecordings.text: Exactly. Between encounters, use what you found and choose when to continue. If a traveller needs help, listen. Not every problem needs a sword.
expandedStoryRecordings.speaker: Diago
